name: Night Terror
descr: Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to perceive you as a nightmarish horror. The targets must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily _Horrified_. While _Horrified_, they're _Vulnerable_. Steal a number of Fear from the GM equal to the number of targets that are _Horrified_ (up to the number of Fear in the GM's pool). Roll a number of **d6s** equal to the number of stolen Fear and deal the total damage to each _Horrified_ target. Discard the stolen Fear.
